subject.title: Feature: Trigger model fallback on context length exceeded

question: Should replay-safe exhausted context overflow enter configured model fallback when a later candidate has verified sufficient context headroom?
rationale: A technically plausible and proof-backed implementation exists, but it changes core model-routing, replay, provider-cost, and compatibility semantics; the prior implementation closed without final product sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor guarded overflow fallback
options.body: Approve a fresh current-main implementation limited to replay-safe exhausted results and candidates with canonical verified context headroom.

options.title: Keep compaction-only policy
options.body: Retain the blocked overflow result and document reset, compaction, or explicit model switching as the supported recovery.

recommendation.title: Sponsor guarded overflow fallback
recommendation.body: Approve a fresh current-main implementation limited to replay-safe exhausted results and candidates with canonical verified context headroom.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history in both controlling paths and has already reviewed this exact product-policy question.
